items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Flight. You, Gary Burton, Jerry Friedman, Tony Levin on bass... [INTERVIEWEE] Wow. Son of a gun. I don’t remember that.

ctx.x: And I played on that track called Flight.
Flight. You, Gary Burton, Jerry Friedman, Tony Levin on bass, rather interesting.
Wow. Son of a gun. I don’t remember that.
